input.content: Pattern: Premature removal of a dual-shape compatibility fallback during an active background migration. In a store that reads both a legacy shape (top-level `address`) and a current nested shape (`destination.address`), a reader fallback branch was deleted as "cleanup" while legacy rows still exist (bounded-batch migration, no startup gate, documented mixed snapshot). Result: the read path (`list_destinations`) raises KeyError on any legacy row, breaking the whole call. Lesson: before deleting a compatibility branch, confirm the migration that retires the old shape has fully completed (telemetry/0 legacy rows), not merely that it exists. Green tests covering only the new shape hide the regression. Check README/contract for "must read both shapes until migration finishes" style hard requirements.
